# Aadhaar Online Services
Explore Aadhaar Online Services including e-Aadhaar download, VID generation, address update, biometric lock/unlock, Aadhaar PVC Card, authentication history and offline e-KYC. These secure digital services enable residents to manage Aadhaar conveniently anytime and anywhere.
